title: Keep an unconfirmed estimate unconfirmed
prompt:
Supplier message: We estimate arrival on 2026-10-14, pending carrier confirmation. Draft says delivery is confirmed. Convert the source into supported status data.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. arrival_date: string; status: estimated or confirmed; pending: carrier_confirmation or none.
remediation_hints: Do not upgrade estimated dates into promises while simplifying a message.
